title: Editorial layer for one briefing
description: What the model returns in production, and what the two committed files in this directory contain as a pre-computed output.

banner.description: Who published this and who did not.

replay.description: Whether the briefing was produced on its own date or reconstructed later.

engine.description: What is being shown and what remains to be built.

scope.description: Which sources were read, and which were deliberately not.

tracked.description: One subject followed across filings: the state before, the change, and one thing left unknown.

key.description: The ranked change or obligation this item answers.

new_since_previous.description: Required when carried_over is true: what is new about a repeated item.

chain.description: Only the steps the records allow. Absent is better than mechanical.

caveat.description: Whose rule it is, and whether anyone has approved it.

carried.description: Open items whose state is kept and whose story has not moved. Listed, not repeated.

items.description: An observation or evidence id in the snapshot.
